item.title: Is It Selfish to Want Good Things to Happen?
item.description: There is always hope in the Lord because He is bigger, stronger, and more powerful than anyone and anything. We can always rely on Him and turn to Him.

item.title: 3 Practical Ways to Beat the February Blues
item.description: Battling persistent depression can feel isolating, but practical strategies like embracing nature, engaging in prayer and journaling, and creating a "cozy happiness kit" can offer tangible relief. Discover actionable steps to nurture your mental well-being and find moments of peace, even on your darkest days.

item.title: How to Pray and Start Your Prayer Life
item.description: Prayer is essential to the Christian life, but it can be difficult to build up a healthy prayer life. You may be feeling unprepared, insecure or just too busy to pray sometimes. How can we work to get started praying regularly, or even to re-energize a stagnant prayer life?

item.title: A Prayer for Contentment in Retirement Years - Your Daily Prayer - February 17
item.description: Retirement isn’t the end of purpose; it’s the beginning of peace. Discover how godly contentment can transform your next chapter.
